from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's relevant financial data for the period."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company as reported")
    accounts_receivable: float = Field(description="Accounts Receivable amount in CNY")
    inventory: float = Field(description="Inventory amount in CNY")
    accounts_payable: float = Field(description="Accounts Payable amount in CNY")
    report_date: str = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all company records extracted from the document collection."""
    financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
